newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya firms seen announcing asset reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya firms seen announcing asset reshuffle.

text.p: Berjaya Leisure Bhd and Berjaya Industrial Bhd will make an announcement on Friday about a mutual transfer of assets, a source at Berjaya Group Bhd said on Wednesday.
Shares of Berjaya Leisure and Berjaya Industrial have been suspended since September 5 pending announcements. Berjaya Group is the parent company of the two firms.
Berjaya Leisure's businesses include gaming and property development and Berjaya Industrial makes steel wires and related products and trades consumer durables.
The source did not disclose any details.
